title: Zillow listing agents
description: ZIP codes, a listing cap, and an agent cap. Filters and the proxy group are optional.

zip_codes.title: ZIP codes
zip_codes.description: US ZIP codes to search. Listings are collected across every ZIP until max_listings is reached.

max_listings.title: Max listings
max_listings.description: Total listings to collect across all ZIP codes.

max_agents.title: Max agents
max_agents.description: Total unique agents to return. The run stops once this many agents are collected.

forSaleByAgent.title: For sale by agent
forSaleByAgent.sectionDescription: Optional filters. The run only needs ZIP codes, max listings, and max agents.

enrich.title: Enrich missing email and phone
enrich.description: Look up agents that are missing an email or phone on Google, the agent site, and the brokerage site. Default on.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy group
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy group for Zillow requests on the platform. Residential is the default. Ignored on a local run. There is no CAPTCHA solver.
